daas-irab:1-1.t:
﴿قَدْ سَمِعَ﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq) and a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿قَوْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is muḍāf. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تُجادِلُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِي زَوْجِها﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَتَشْتَكِي﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَسْمَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿تَحاوُرَكُما﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ﴾ inna, its noun (ism) and its two khabars; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يُظاهِرُونَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ نِسائِهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ negative, operating like ليس. ﴿هُنَّ أُمَّهاتِهِمْ﴾ its noun (ism) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of الذين, and the clause الذين.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative. ﴿أُمَّهاتِهِمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اللَّائِي﴾ the relative noun is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَدْنَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَيَقُولُونَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of إنهم, and the nominal clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿مُنْكَراً﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنَ الْقَوْلِ﴾ a ṣifa of منكر. ﴿وَزُوراً﴾ conjoined to منكرا. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ﴾ inna and its noun, the shifted lām, and عفو غفور are two khabars; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُظاهِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ نِسائِهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَعُودُونَ﴾ conjoined to يظاهرون. ﴿لِما﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿فَتَحْرِيرُ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and تحرير is a mubtadaʾ, and it is muḍāf. ﴿رَقَبَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين, and the clause الذين.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ both attached to تحرير. ﴿أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is its fāʿil; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿تُوعَظُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the verbal clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to خبير. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿خَبِيرٌ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَمْ يَجِدْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿فَصِيامُ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and صيام is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar (predicate) is omitted. ﴿شَهْرَيْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُتَتابِعَيْنِ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of شهرين; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clauses of the condition and its apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) صيام. ﴿أَنْ يَتَمَاسَّا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the alif is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by لم. ﴿فَإِطْعامُ﴾ the fāʾ is connective. ﴿إطعام﴾ a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted; the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of من.., and the clause فمن لم.. is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿سِتِّينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ. ﴿مِسْكِيناً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿لِتُؤْمِنُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an أن concealed after the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَرَسُولِهِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ a ṣifa of عذاب; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿يُحَادُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿كُبِتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كَما كُبِتَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition of comparison (tashbīh), ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and a passive past verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila of the relative noun; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ما and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿أَنْزَلْنا آياتٍ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾ a ṣifa of آيات; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلِلْكافِرِينَ﴾ a fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُهِينٌ﴾ a ṣifa of عذاب; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time. ﴿يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَيُنَبِّئُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent (mustatir). ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَحْصاهُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَنَسُوهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ both attached to شهيد. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شَهِيدٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ anna and its noun (ism). ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause ألم تر.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿يَكُونُ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْ نَجْوى﴾ genitive in form by the redundant (zāʾida) من, nominative in position as the fāʿil of يكون. ﴿ثَلاثَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ رابِعُهُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿خَمْسَةٍ﴾ conjoined to ثلاثة. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿هُوَ سادِسُهُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿أَدْنى﴾ conjoined to the form (lafẓ) of نجوى. ﴿مِنْ ذلِكَ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) أدنى. ﴿وَلا أَكْثَرَ﴾ conjoined to ولا أدنى. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿هُوَ مَعَهُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿أَيْنَ ما﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of place, and ما is redundant. ﴿كانُوا﴾ a complete past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُنَبِّئُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿عَمِلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun. [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿أَنَّ﴾ but parses it as إنّ; the Quranic text has ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾.] ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ both attached to عليم. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ the khabar of إن; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ see the previous verse. ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿نُهُوا﴾ a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَنِ النَّجْوى﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَعُودُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِما﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿نُهُوا﴾ a passive past verb and the nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَيَتَناجَوْنَ﴾ conjoined to يعودون. ﴿بِالْإِثْمِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَالْعُدْوانِ﴾ conjoined to الإثم. ﴿وَمَعْصِيَةِ﴾ conjoined to العدوان. ﴿الرَّسُولِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِذا﴾ an adverbial (ẓarfiyya), non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿جاؤُكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿حَيَّوْكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). ﴿يُعَذِّبُنَا﴾ an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause يعذبنا is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿نَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَصْلَوْنَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the verbal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَبِئْسَ﴾ an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm). ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverbial (ẓarfiyya), non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَناجَيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَلا تَتَناجَوْا﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْإِثْمِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَالْعُدْوانِ وَمَعْصِيَةِ﴾ both conjoined to الإثم. ﴿الرَّسُولِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَتَناجَوْا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِالْبِرِّ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَالتَّقْوى﴾ conjoined to البر. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of الله. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ both attached to تحشرون. ﴿تُحْشَرُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:10-10.t:
﴿إِنَّمَا﴾ the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿النَّجْوى﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position.
﴿لِيَحْزُنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after the lām of reason (lām al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second khabar. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun (ism) latent (mustatir). ﴿بِضارِّهِمْ﴾ genitive in form, accusative in position as the khabar of ليس. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a conjunction, and both attached to يتوكل. ﴿فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command (lām al-amr). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذا﴾ its i'rab has gone before. ﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿تَفَسَّحُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي الْمَجالِسِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿فَافْسَحُوا﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَفْسَحِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَإِذا قِيلَ انْشُزُوا فَانْشُزُوا﴾ the i'rab of its like has gone before. ﴿يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْعِلْمَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿دَرَجاتٍ﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ﴾ its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿ناجَيْتُمُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الرَّسُولَ﴾ its object; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَقَدِّمُوا﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of place, and it is muḍāf. ﴿يَدَيْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نَجْواكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿صَدَقَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ذلِكَ خَيْرٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير. ﴿وَأَطْهَرُ﴾ conjoined to خير. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle and إن is conditional. ﴿لَمْ تَجِدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun (ism) and its two khabars; the nominal clause gives the reason (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:13-13.t:
﴿أَأَشْفَقْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ تُقَدِّمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the clause أشفقتم is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْواكُمْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿صَدَقاتٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا﴾ إذ is an adverb (ẓarf) for past time, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the wāw is its fāʿil; and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the clause إذ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَتابَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ﴾ the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the response (jawāb) of إذ, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَآتُوا الزَّكاةَ، وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ both conjoined to what precedes them.
﴿وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِلَى الَّذِينَ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ألم تر is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿غَضِبَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is a ṣifa (adjective) of قوما. ﴿ما﴾ negative, without operation. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ conjoined to منكم. ﴿وَيَحْلِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلَى الْكَذِبِ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and a mubtadaʾ, and يعلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the verbal clause is the khabar of هم, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شَدِيداً﴾ a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿ساءَ﴾ a past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm), and the fāʿil is necessarily latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾ an indefinite noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the accusative as tamyīz (specification); the clause ساء is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and the clause إنهم.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا, and the verbal clause is a ṣifa of ما.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿اتَّخَذُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَيْمانَهُمْ﴾ its first object. ﴿جُنَّةً﴾ its second object; the verbal clause is explicative (mufassira) of the clause ساء... ﴿فَصَدُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَلَهُمْ﴾ a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُهِينٌ﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of عذاب; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿لَنْ تُغْنِيَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَمْوالُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَلا أَوْلادُهُمْ﴾ conjoined to أموالهم. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to تغني. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿أُولئِكَ أَصْحابُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿هُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ﴾ an adverb (ẓarf) of time, and an imperfect verb and its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَيَحْلِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to يبعثهم. ﴿لَهُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كَما﴾ a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يَحْلِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, the wāw its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَيَحْسَبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ anna and its noun (ism). ﴿عَلى شَيْءٍ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of أنهم; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of يحسبون. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh) and opening (istiftāḥ). ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ inna and its noun. [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ but parses it as إنّ; the Quranic text has ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾.] ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْكاذِبُونَ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿اسْتَحْوَذَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِمُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَنْساهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its first object, the fāʿil being latent (mustatir). ﴿ذِكْرَ﴾ its second object. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أُولئِكَ حِزْبُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh) and opening (istiftāḥ). ﴿إِنَّ حِزْبَ﴾ inna and its noun (ism). ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: in both places the source prints the muḍāf ilayhi as ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ with ḍamma; the Quranic text has ﴿الشَّيْطانِ﴾.] ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْخاسِرُونَ﴾ the khabar of إن; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحَادُّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي الْأَذَلِّينَ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause أولئك is the khabar of إن, and the clause إن is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿كَتَبَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَأَغْلِبَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis. ﴿أَنَا﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent (mustatir) fāʿil. ﴿وَرُسُلِي﴾ conjoined to أنا; the clause is the response to the omitted oath (jawāb al-qasam), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ﴾ inna, its noun (ism) and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:22-22.t:
﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَجِدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is a ṣifa (adjective) of قوما. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾ a ṣifa of اليوم; the clause لا تجد..
is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يُوادُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿حَادَّ اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined to الله; and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is for the ḥāl, and لو is connective (waṣliyya). ﴿كانُوا آباءَهُمْ﴾ kāna, its noun (ism) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿أَوْ أَبْناءَهُمْ أَوْ إِخْوانَهُمْ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to آباءهم. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَتَبَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar of أولئك, and the nominal clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿الْإِيمانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَيَّدَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, the fāʿil being latent. ﴿بِرُوحٍ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a ṣifa of روح; the clause is conjoined to كتب. ﴿وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first object, the fāʿil being latent. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is a ṣifa of جنات. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to خالدين. ﴿رَضِيَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ both attached to the verb. ﴿وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أُولئِكَ حِزْبُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ with fatḥa; as muḍāf ilayhi the Quranic text has ﴿اللَّهِ﴾.] The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَلا إِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded at no. 19.
